title: Adult Human Kidney Tissue Cell Dissociation on Ice
author: Andrew Potter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q6cdzaw

steps.title: Mince and weigh kidney tissue
steps.instruction: Mince the biopsy on ice into ~1 mm³ pieces with a razor blade, then weigh 10 mg of the minced tissue.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to enzyme mix on ice
steps.instruction: Place the 10 mg tissue into a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL enzyme mix and keep on ice.

steps.title: Incubate with periodic shaking and trituration
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 30 min while shaking the tube every 1 min; starting at 2 min, triturate 10 times every 3 min using a P1000 set to 700 µL with the tip cut off.

substeps.instruction: Starting at 2 min, triturate 10 times every 3 min with a P1000 pipette (700 µL, tip cut off).

steps.title: Settle tissue and collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: After the 30‑min incubation, let the tissue chunks settle on ice for 1 min, then transfer the flow‑through to a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Dilute flow‑through with PBS/BSA 0.04 %
steps.instruction: Bring the volume of the flow‑through to 10 mL with ice‑cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Add second enzyme aliquot and continue incubation
steps.instruction: Add an additional 1 mL enzyme mix to the tube with tissue chunks and continue shaking every minute and triturating 10 times every 3 min while incubating on ice for another 50 min (total 1 h 20 min).

substeps.instruction: Shake every 1 min and triturate 10 times every 3 min (same conditions as before) for 50 min.

steps.title: Filter digest and rinse filter
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire digest volume to a new 30 µm filter placed on a 50 mL conical tube, then rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

substeps.instruction: Pass digest through 30 µm filter into 50 mL conical.
Rinse filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Combine filtrates, adjust volume, and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Collect the flow‑through, bring its volume to 10 mL with ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA, then spin both this tube and the previous layer tube at 650 g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Bring volume to 10 mL with ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.
Spin both tubes at 650 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: RBC lysis and dilution
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL RBC lysis buffer to the combined tube, triturate 20 times with a 1 mL pipette, incubate on ice for 3 min, then add 10 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA to dilute the lysis buffer.

steps.title: Centrifuge and retain cell pellet
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 650 g for 5 min at 4 °C and remove all supernatant except ~100 µL remaining.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in ~100 µL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA, then determine cell viability and concentration using a hemocytometer with trypan blue.

steps.title: Remove excess supernatant and filter again
steps.instruction: Remove 80 % of the supernatant (released cells), apply the remaining suspension to a 30 µm filter on a 50 mL conical tube, and rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

substeps.instruction: Filter remaining suspension through 30 µm filter.
Rinse filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA.

steps.title: Final centrifugation and resuspension in PBS
steps.instruction: Spin the flow‑through at 650 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, then resuspend cells in 10 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 10 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA; keep on ice.

steps.title: Second RBC lysis and final wash
steps.instruction: To 100 µL of the cell suspension add 900 µL RBC lysis buffer, triturate 10 times, incubate 1 min on ice, add 10 mL ice‑cold PBS/0.04 % BSA, spin at 650 g for 5 min at 4 °C, and remove as much supernatant as possible.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL RBC lysis buffer to 100 µL cells.
Remove as much supernatant as possible.
